source_observation: score_people builds one row per supplied interval ID/boundary pair, computes the arithmetic mean of row fisher_z_spearman within each person, then the arithmetic mean across people. No stimulus-identity grouping is present. All120 intervals/person are required by operator/public contract.
scientific_dependence: The70 unique source sentence identities and repeated presentations are dependence groups for later uncertainty analysis, not a replacement weighting for the canonical primary.
retained_semantics: Average ranks for ties; signed raw Spearman and Pearson remain reported.
Exactly +/-1 is clipped only for finite Fisher transform; raw endpoint coefficients remain.
Constant prediction is valid with correlation0 and explicit flag; constant target invalidates the operator packet, never dropped.
Full24person and2880interval coverage required; source/source-code checks are not numerical qualification.
separate_preparation_clarification: Original audiobook preprocessing uses all source-declared available runs, removes author-defined short epochs (<99% of120s), and trims retained audio/neuro epochs to global retained minimum length. The future preparation ledger must record these source-defined exclusions rather than claim all raw samples. OLSA source retains duration+0.5s and at most one-sample shorter-length matching.
separate_presentation_clarification: Existing source produces sub-XX:sentence-NNN labels in source order; a future privately randomized alias/order view must preserve all original intervals/sample boundaries and matched views. It is not contamination proof.
